command: sudo -n bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; echo ===IDENTITY===; hostname; id -un; echo ===SERVICE_STATE===; systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service || true; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager; echo ===MANIFEST===; test -f /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; sha256sum /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; stat -c "%U:%G %a %s %y %n" /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; echo ===CONFIG_BINDS===; grep -n "^ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS=" /etc/entityos/entityos.conf; echo ===CUTOVER_CONDITION===; /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition; echo CUTOVER_CONDITION_RC=$?; echo ===DONE==='
